name: agentcave
description: Self-hosted runtime for Markdown-defined AI agents with a bash sandbox, an HTTP API and a live web UI.

scripts.demo: npm run build -w @agentcave/web && npm run demo -w @agentcave/server
scripts.build: npm run build -w @agentcave/client && npm run build -w @agentcave/web && npm run build -w @agentcave/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @agentcave/client && npm run typecheck -w @agentcave/server && npm run typecheck -w @agentcave/web
